Run and compare

python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
python -B support/verify_release.py
python -B support/run_notebook.py
python -B artifacts/x5_envelope.py

Run from the extracted MQM_0.5 folder. The verifier checks hashes and compares parsed outputs with the expected JSON. Jupyter is optional; the lightweight runner executes the notebook’s code cells.

Expected subsystem JSON · Expected X5 JSON · File manifest

The X5 adapter reinitializes computational-basis frames between rounds. It verifies the declared X-only model; it does not establish preservation of arbitrary logical coherence. Stim simulator introspection is not experimental readout.

Five-step review workflow

  1. 1. DefineFix branch, task, error assumptions and resource budget.
  2. 2. VerifyCheck operators, distance and counterexamples.
  3. 3. CompileSpecify interactions, measurements, reset and feedback.
  4. 4. StressRecord residuals, failures and readout limitations.
  5. 5. CompareUse a frozen task, noise model and matched baseline.

The two replay entry points cover selected checks, not this entire workflow. Review success is an independent replay, a reproducible disagreement, or a written counterexample.
